findings.evidence: "A small formative task test finds discoverability failures but does not establish rates or differences." Much of Procedure and NEVER activates familiar research-review practices; the distinctive knowledge is concentrated in the preloaded-skill integration and output contract.
findings.fix: Condense the conventional task-framing, research-method and evidence-hygiene reminders into a shorter activation checklist. Preserve the source-precedence policy, input-specific verification boundaries, causal-inference guardrails and repository-specific table contract.

findings.evidence: "End with the single change that gives the biggest win, then the sources." The workflow has no explicit exit when a review establishes no worthwhile improvement, or when insufficient evidence supports any change; both still reach this unconditional change requirement.
findings.fix: Add two explicit outcomes: when no supported improvement is found, conclude "No change recommended"; when evidence is insufficient, name the next observation or test needed instead of prescribing a redesign. Allow either outcome to satisfy the completion condition.
